decisions.decision: Phases 19-22 share TWO root causes (construct + power), not four; Phase 22 hit both simultaneously
decisions.rationale: Short-claim-to-long-form judge transfer collapses AUROC 0.90 -> 0.53 (arXiv 2606.23915), so the Phase-22 calibration could not have transferred even on a PASS; and a point-estimate MCC gate at n=60 false-fails ~47% against a judge at its own bar (verified by in-session simulation). This reframes the record from 'unmapped solution space' to a named, recurring pair of causes.

decisions.decision: Phase 23 selects only confidence sources needing NEITHER a calibrated judge NOR closed-book gold
decisions.rationale: Those are the only designs structurally immune to both recurring root causes. The enabling reframe: the gold requirement was always downstream of the JUDGE requirement -- remove the judge and D-18's free-dataset-gold constraint stops binding, because nothing is left to anchor.

decisions.decision: D-13's calibration disqualifier is a design choice, not a methodological requirement, and is NOT carried into Phase 23
decisions.rationale: No major framework imposes a pre-use disqualifier gate; Anthropic's own guidance is calibrate-and-iterate plus 'choose deterministic graders where possible'. D-01 explicitly rejected a bar exceeding the blessed reference's own, and D-13 reintroduced one at the instrument layer.

decisions.decision: Slice A is re-frozen under Phase 23's own pre-registration rather than argued to have survived Phase 22's halt
decisions.rationale: AMENDMENT RECORD 3's enumerated bans are all judge-instrument moves and never name Stage 4, and PAR-06's only precondition (the feasibility gate) is RESOLVED FEASIBLE -- but 22-05-PLAN.md is TERMINAL and the amendment routes everything remaining to a NEW phase. Re-freezing is clean; re-opening is not.

decisions.decision: The n<=5 significance ceiling is stated in the pre-registration IN ADVANCE, not discovered at the end
decisions.rationale: At n<=5 the two-sided sign-test minimum is 2 x 0.5^5 = 0.0625, so no superiority claim is reachable by construction. Stating it up front means a phase ending without significance is not read as falling short.

decisions.decision: Recommended sequencing: Slice A + deterministic citation audit unconditionally; head-to-head grading gated behind a capture-feasibility spike; terminate-with-envelope pre-registered as the guaranteed floor; DECLINE a third judge instrument
decisions.rationale: Options 1/2/4 in the ranking are exposed to neither recurring failure mode. Fixing the judge is void on success and costs the most.
